findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_tense_zone, check_rent_control_perimeter, check_airport_noise_zone · Private data: prepare_lease_draft · Public sink: prepare_lease_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_tense_zone, check_rent_control_perimeter, check_airport_noise_zone · Private data: prepare_lease_draft · Public sink: prepare_lease_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
